result.instructions: Tools for Referrals.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my campaigns had the most participants this month?"; "Show the stats for my Summer Promo campaign: clicks, shares and signups."; "Who joined my referral campaign 10 most recently, and who invited them?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Referrals.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run referrals_com_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run referrals_com_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run referrals_com_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. referrals_com_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_profile
tools.title: Get account profile
tools.description: Get the Referrals.com account that the API key belongs to: name, email and plan. Good first call to confirm the key works. API: GET /v1/members/profile.

tools.name: referrals_com_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List the brands (websites) in the account. A brand owns campaigns. API: GET /v1/brands.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_brand
tools.title: Get brand
tools.description: Get one brand by id: its URL, domain, description and logo. API: GET /v1/brands/{brandId}.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_brand_stats
tools.title: Get brand stats
tools.description: Get analytics for one brand: campaigns, participants, shares, clicks and impressions. API: GET /v1/brands/{brandId}/stats.

tools.name: referrals_com_create_brand
tools.title: Create brand
tools.description: Create a brand (a website that runs referral campaigns). Creates a new record; it is not undone by a retry. API: POST /v1/brands.

url.description: The brand website, for example https://mybrand.com.

tools.name: referrals_com_update_brand
tools.title: Update brand
tools.description: Change a brand's description or logo URL. Fields you omit stay as they are. API: PUT /v1/brands/{brandId}.

tools.name: referrals_com_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns, optionally for one brand. API: GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its widget, reward and contest settings. API: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign stats
tools.description: Get campaign stats: participants, shares, clicks, impressions and daily signups. API: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/stats.

tools.name: referrals_com_create_campaign
tools.title: Create campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign under a brand. Creates a new record. The reward_type and type_id codes are not listed in the public docs: check them in the dashboard first. API: POST /v1/campaigns.

name.description: Campaign name, for example Summer Promo.

brand_id.description: Brand the campaign belongs to (the API field is url_id).

tools.name: referrals_com_update_campaign
tools.title: Update campaign
tools.description: Change a campaign's name or publish setting. Fields you omit stay as they are. API: PUT /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}.

publish.description: Publish setting as the API takes it, for example public.

tools.name: referrals_com_list_participants
tools.title: List participants
tools.description: List participants (people who joined a referral campaign), optionally for one campaign. API: GET /v1/participants.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_participant
tools.title: Get participant
tools.description: Get one participant with their shares, rewards and invited emails. API: GET /v1/participants/{participantId}.

tools.name: referrals_com_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook URLs registered in the account. API: GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: referrals_com_get_lander
tools.title: Get lander settings
tools.description: Get the lander page settings of one campaign: template, header and footer text, background, brand and social links. API: GET /v1/lander.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Referrals.com
prompts.description: What you can do with Referrals.com here, with example requests to try.
